description: Lock a price (10 minutes) for one purchase. Returns quoteId, exact USDC price and what will be delivered. Free. ALWAYS show the human the price and the recipient before buying.

amount.description: for range offers: amount in the recipient's local currency

fields.description: bill-pay / payout recipient fields the offer lists in requiredFields (account_number, bank_code, full_name, vpa, iban…)

offerId.description: the offer's offerId from list_offers or lookup_phone, e.g. ea-JC063

payer.description: the Algorand address you will pay from (required for payout compliance when this server holds no wallet)

ref.description: referrer's Algorand address — earns a share of margin if the order is delivered (GET /v1/referrals)

sender.description: payouts only: the principal (legal name + country); reference = partner KYC id, required above $100/day

type.description: the offer's type, as list_offers returned it

name: quote
